ruleDefinitions.name: Uncommon Connection to Active Directory Web Services
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects uncommon network connections to the Active Directory Web Services (ADWS) from processes not typically associated with ADWS management.

sequences.query: (network_initiated = "True" AND dest_port = 9389) AND  NOT (process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\system32\\dsac\.exe" OR process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\\Microsoft\ Monitoring\ Agent\\" OR (process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\PowerShell\\\\7\\\\pwsh\\\.exe") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\PowerShell\\\\7\\-preview\\\\pwsh\\\.ex") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\WindowsPowerShell\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\WindowsPowerShell\\\\")))
